title: SLI Attribution Ledger and Roll-forward Policy for Initiative Lifecycle
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Create a durable, audit-friendly ledger and an operational roll-forward policy that attributes SLI changes and error-budget consumption to discrete initiatives across cycles. This playbook will remove ambiguity about which initiative(s) consumed an error budget, how SLI baseline shifts are recorded, and how ownership transfers when initiatives span cycles or when multiple initiatives overlap on the same services.

Scope:
- Define ledger schema for SLI attribution entries (service, metric, time window, initiative(s), attribution fraction, evidence links, author, timestamp).
- Define roll-forward rules for partially completed initiatives: carry-forward attribution, rewind windows when remediation is implemented, and retroactive adjustments policy.
- Create operational runbook for PMs + oncall: how to tag initiative telemetry, required evidence for retroactive edits, and approval chain.
- Implement a view in the Initiative Hub (Console) showing per-initiative SLI consumption, inferred root causes, and recommended mitigations.
- Draft automation requirements for periodic ledger reconciliation and alerts when attribution ambiguity exceeds thresholds.

Out-of-scope (for this ticket): schema enforcement in observability backend and the full automation implementation in the runtime. Those will be follow-ups with ENG teams.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger schema document reviewed and approved by Reliability PM, Observability eng lead, and Security
Roll-forward policy documented with concrete rules for: carry-forward, partial-credit, and retroactive edits
Runbook drafted with step-by-step actions for PMs and oncall responders
Mockups for Initiative Hub ledger view approved by Design and Product
Dependencies and automation requirements captured and triaged into ENG backlog
comments: 2025-02-12: Ticket created during reliability planning session. Problem statement captured: teams struggle to reconcile SLI drops with initiative timelines; current postmortems are inconsistent about attribution.

2025-02-13: Quick sync with Observability (Jules Park). Observability prefers ledger entries as minimal JSON blobs with references to existing timeseries IDs; concerns raised about storage volume and query performance.

2025-02-14: Design input (Priya Singh): proposed compact ledger UI that surfaces top-2 attributed initiatives per SLI incident with links to evidence cards. Asked for acceptance criteria for mockups by 2025-02-18.
2025-02-15: Security review triage: no sensitive data required in ledger; recommend hashing any PII in evidence links. Security flagged retention policy—we should include retention TTL in schema.

2025-02-17: Product-led decision: roll-forward policy will support two modes: conservative (no retroactive credit without audit trail) and pragmatic (allow retroactive adjustments with 2-step approval). Action: document both and recommend default conservative.

2025-02-18: Link review with ENG owners (ENG-22145 owner: Lin Gomez). Lin suggests adding an attribution confidence score and a provenance array (list of telemetry artifacts) — will impact schema but accepted as optional field.
2025-02-19: Draft mockups uploaded to Drive and request for 1-hour design review in Cycle planning slot. Action assigned to Design: Priya to finalize low-fidelity mockups by 2025-02-21.

2025-02-20: Updated ticket with finalized acceptance criteria and moved to Planned. Next steps: schedule cross-team workshop (PM, Observability, Security, Design, Eng runtime) for 2025-02-25 to finalize schema and automation requirements.
decision_log: 2025-02-15: Default policy = conservative roll-forward (no retroactive credit without evidence + approval).
2025-02-17: Include optional attribution confidence score to aid triage; not required for minimal ledger entry.
2025-02-19: Retention TTL will be configurable per org, default 540 days.
next_steps: Book cross-team schema workshop for 2025-02-25 (invite Observability, Eng runtime, Security, Design)
Design to produce two mockups: ledger detail card and initiative summary row by 2025-02-21
Eng to estimate schema enforcement and simple reconciliation job after workshop
PM to draft approval workflow and a short training doc for oncall/PMs
